items.title: 61529_Maxine Sullivan oral history interview
items.q: I knew the musicians and the musicians knew me, but I wasn't part of the scene. I wasn't a working performer.

around at that time. Then there was the north side from which Billy Eckst[e]in and Roy Eldridge are from. There's a lot of good musicians from that part of town -- sort of north of Pittsburgh, across the Allegheny River and they played in downtown Pittsburgh. And these would be the musicians that I would run into at the Crawford Grill upn Wylie Avenue.

Although I went to affairs quite frequently and I heard a lot of music. I wasn't part of the scene, you know, I was just an observer more or less. I mean, I wasn't known downtown Pittsburgh as one of the local entertainers. It took me a little while to establish myself. I knew the musicians and the musicians knew me, but I wasn't part of the scene. I wasn't a working performer.
